name: Echo Room VR: Escape the Dark
summary:
**To see the way out, you must break the silence.**

*Echo Room VR* is a gripping first-person puzzle-exploration game that plunges you into absolute darkness. Trapped blind inside a derelict research facility, your only lifelines are a mysterious alter ego guiding you and your ability to create sound.
